svg.aria-label: Diagram of the two-tap dynamic convolution. Top: one drafter layer with a convolution before and after each attention and MLP sublayer, repeated five times. Bottom, zoomed into one convolution: each position takes one tap on itself and one on its predecessor, and the first position reads the last verified token.
svg.desc: Source: Inco AI, DFlash 2: Keep Drafting Parallel, https://inco.ai/blog/dflash2/#figure-4. Static export of the official diagram.
